verdict_reason: This PR only re-packages the file (rename, 97% similarity); MDC clear-in-finally, x-cdp-request-id header naming, filter ordering and PII exposure all check out, leaving one Minor dead-MDC-key nit.

todos.fix: Either drop the MDC_HTTP_STATUS put, or emit a single request-completion log line (log.info) immediately after setting it, before the finally clears MDC; add an EcsLoggingIT assertion for http.response.status_code
